# hpe_morpheus_clusters (Data Source)



-> The `cloud_id` and `type_id` filters are applied server-side. The `filter` block applies client-side filtering including `dynamic_placement_mode`, which is extracted from each cluster's config and exposed as a typed attribute for reliable filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_clusters" "example" {
  filter {
    name   = "dynamic_placement_mode"
    values = ["on"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (Number) Filter by cloud ID. Only clusters in this cloud are returned.
- `filter` (Block Set) Filter block. Repeat to apply multiple filters (all ANDed together). Filter values are case-sensitive and support Go regular expressions (https://regex101.com/). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `type_id` (Number) Filter by cluster type ID. Only clusters of this type are returned.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes Set) The list of clusters matching the supplied filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field to filter on. Valid names are: name, status, type_code, type_name, cloud_id, cloud_name, dynamic_placement_mode.
- `values` (Set of String) The filter values. A cluster matches the block if the chosen field matches ANY value (Go regular expression).


<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud this cluster belongs to.
- `cloud_name` (String) The name of the cloud this cluster belongs to.
- `description` (String) The description of the cluster.
- `dynamic_placement_mode` (String) The dynamic placement mode for the cluster, extracted from the cluster config. Observed values are "on" and "off". Null for cluster types that do not support dynamic placement.
- `group_id` (Number) The ID of the group this cluster belongs to.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the cluster.
- `labels` (Set of String) The labels associated with the cluster.
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster.
- `status` (String) The status of the cluster (e.g. provisioned, warning).
- `type_code` (String) The stable code of the cluster type, for example "mvm-cluster" or
"kubernetes-cluster". Prefer this over type_name for filtering: codes
are stable identifiers, whereas display names change (the mvm-cluster
type is now displayed as "HVM").

Not present on the cluster response itself; resolved from the cluster
types endpoint.
- `type_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster type.
- `type_name` (String) The name of the cluster type.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the cluster (public or private).
